diagnostic_evidence.quote: Assume that these intervals do not overlap, that is, $\sqrt{1- z^2} \leq z \iff z \geq 1/\sqrt{2}$.

issues.failure_explanation: The admitted range includes z = 1/sqrt(2) and z = 1, but the coefficient denominators vanish at both. At the first endpoint the two interpolation conditions coincide, so they do not determine a unique cubic. At z = 1, the first condition becomes p(0) = 1, impossible for an odd polynomial. The claimed strict lower bound p(1) > 1/sqrt(2) also becomes equality at the continuous limit of the first endpoint.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use the quotient formula only for 1/sqrt(2) < z < 1. At z = 1/sqrt(2), explicitly select the limiting cubic with a = 3/sqrt(2), b = -sqrt(2), and use the non-strict bound. At z = 1, return the normalized input, which is already its rank-reduced polar factor.
issues.overall_effect: The preprocessing construction is not defined for a touching-gap case or for a normalized rank-one input, both allowed by the stated assumptions.
issues.title: The spectral-gap initialization is undefined at admitted endpoints
issues.why_classification: Explicit endpoint branches preserve the construction and acceleration claims throughout the genuine-gap regime.
